findings.where: 0LCVO-ABR method ('closed vial') and step 4 description ('in the container')
findings.extracted: kept at 80 °C for 24 h in a closed vial with an open vial of water ; step 4: dry the sample in the container
findings.article_says: The obtained mixture was transferred into a 20 mL glass vial which was added another open 3 mL vial containing 1 mL of distilled water.
findings.fix: The article never says the outer 20 mL vial is closed, capped or sealed (only the inner 3 mL vial is 'open'); step 2 itself declares closure_of_outer_vial not_stated, so the route 'method' text contradicts it. Replace 'closed vial' by 'a 20 mL vial containing an open 3 mL vial of water' and drop 'in the container' from step 4 (the article only says the samples were dried at the same temperature after the water vial was taken out; lid state during drying is also unstated). Matters for the safety annotation too (pressure).

findings.extracted: parent = 3LCVO-ABR, so grinding, 20 mL vial + 3 mL water vial, 80 °C 24 h, drying 12 h, re-grinding are inherited; structure 'orthorhombic (XRD, Supplementary Fig. 10)'
findings.article_says: The XRD pattern of the Mg-doped sample in Supplementary Fig. 10 can be used to determine the purity of the prepared sample
findings.fix: The only description is 'Ca was replaced by magnesium (Mg2+) (at the same content)'; no phrase says the Mg sample followed the ABR procedure (the suffix -ABR is the only hint), and the article does not say the Mg sample is orthorhombic, only that its XRD shows purity. RUNBOOK 'pas d'héritage non fondé': either give 3LMVO-ABR its own steps or declare them not_stated, keeping the doubt, and remove 'orthorhombic' (put 'phase pure per XRD, Supp. Fig. 10, not shown in repository').

findings.extracted: 2LCVO-ABR is a branch of 0LCVO-ABR with dopant 2 % Ca, all steps inherited
findings.article_says: In a typical process, LiOH H2O, CaO, and V2O5 with the stoichiometric mole percentage (x% = 0, 1, 3, and 5%) was well mixed and ground in mortar.
findings.fix: Methods list x = 0, 1, 3, 5 only; x = 2 exists only in the Results sentence 'xLCVO-ABR (x = 0, 1, 2, 3, 5 ...' and Supplementary Tables 1 and 3. The branch is reasonable and its only data (Supp. Table 1 lattice parameters) match the Supp. Table 1 column '2LCVO-ABR', but add an annotation limite_reproductibilite saying the preparation of the 2 % sample is not described in Methods. Not extracted for 2LCVO-ABR: chi2 1.295, Rwp 3.58, Rp 2.91 (Supp. Table 1) and the structural table (Supp. Table 3, Li/Ca occupancy 0.98/0.02).

findings.article_says: The estimated ratio of V4+/V5+ in the doped samples was 34.52% which is 5.21 times higher than that of pure material (6.63%).
findings.fix: The sentence says 'the doped samples' (plural) and 'pure material', without naming 3LCVO-ABR/0LCVO-ABR; the previous sentence only uses 3LCVO-ABR as an example of the fit, and the XPS series of Supplementary Fig. 11a also contains 3LCVO-SSR. The attribution is plausible (6.63 x 5.21 = 34.5) but inferred: keep, but mark it (doubt already present, add a note in the result or an annotation) and do not read it as 3LCVO-ABR-only evidence. The 6.8 % / 30.4 % O1s values name 3LCVO-ABR and 'the pristine sample' explicitly.

findings.where: annotation tendance_observee (surface specific increase with Ca then retention maximum at 3 %)
findings.extracted: 'Le dopage Ca en voie ABR augmente la surface spécifique et la porosité, puis la rétention de capacité passe par un maximum à 3 % de Ca.'
findings.article_says: These results demonstrate that the combination of ABR and Ca doping induces a mesoporous morphology and significantly increases the specific surface area.
findings.fix: BET is measured only for 0LCVO-ABR, 3LCVO-ABR (and 3LMVO-ABR), not on a Ca series, so 'augmente ... puis' presents a two-point comparison as a trend; the retention maximum at 3 % (92.72, 94.27, 89.72 %) is supported (article: 'The decrease in capacity retention beyond doping concentration of 3%'). Reword: surface area increases between 0 and 3 % Ca; retention peaks at 3 %.

reproducibility_gaps: Masses/moles of LiOH·H2O, V2O5 and CaO and batch size are absent (article and Supplementary Information): only 'stoichiometric mole percentage (x% = 0, 1, 3, and 5%)'; the base of x % (per V, per Li, per Li3VO4) and the substitution stoichiometry are not given (Rietveld occupancies 0.01/0.02/0.03/0.05 for Ca suggest x/100 Ca per formula unit, not stated).
Whether the 20 mL vial is closed/capped, oven type and humidity control, grinding time/fineness, atmosphere of drying and the temperature of the 12 h drying ('same temperature') are not written.

SSR route entirely absent: precursors, Ca source, amounts, annealing temperature, time, ramp and atmosphere are only 'following reference' (ref 9, Li et al. 2013, an undoped Li3VO4 paper) and 'After annealing process'.
Mg-doped 3LMVO-ABR: Mg precursor, amount and whether the ABR procedure was used are not stated; Supp. Fig. 10 is not in the repository.
In situ Raman experiment: cell, temperature, humidity, laser and the relation between the 270-360 min times and the 24 h bulk reaction are not given.

Full cells: electrolyte, separator, cathode composition and loading, cell format and the current density of the NMC622║CG cell (only on Fig. 4f) are not given; the half-cell protocol states 100 mAh g-1 (typo) and the coating method/thickness/pressing are not stated.

Table 1 vs Supplementary Table 1 disagree for 3LCVO-ABR lattice parameters; Supp. Table 5 theoretical row of 3LCVO-SSR repeats the 1 % row; 0LCVO-ABR 200-cycle capacity 268.7 (text) vs about 232 (Fig. 4b); Methods list x = 0, 1, 3, 5 but 2 % is used in Results/SI.
mechanism_check: ok : réaction V2O5 + 6 LiOH -> 2 Li3VO4 + 3 H2O équilibrée, vapeur d'eau à 80 °C ≈ 0,47 bar (SI : 354,5 mmHg), mecanisme_auteurs conforme au paragraphe Raman ; une seule réserve, la phrase de tendance sur la surface BET (voir constats).
notes: Les 15 valeurs from_figure vérifiées sur les images : Fig. 4b à 200 cycles (1LCVO 310 lu 313 ; 5LCVO 360 lu 364 ; 3LCVO-SSR 190 lu 189 ; 0LCVO-SSR 130 lu 132), Fig. 4c palier 800 mA g-1 (0LCVO-ABR 250 lu 254 ; 1LCVO 290 lu 288 ; 3LCVO 520 lu 519 ; 5LCVO 400 lu 407 ; 0LCVO-SSR 150 lu 144 ; 3LCVO-SSR 210 lu 206), Fig. 5f imprimé (34.4/45.9/47.4/48.7/51.2/60.9) : tous à moins de 5 %, aucun constat. Tables 3, 4, 7 et Supp. Table 5 (Ca) revérifiées rangée par rangée : correctes. Les citations des valeurs Fig. 5f commencent au milieu d'un mot ('f the contribution ...') : sous-chaîne valide mais à retailler. L'inventaire de l'extracteur correspond à ma liste (11 voies, plus graphite commerciale, modèles DFT et autres composés ABR de la Supp. Table 15 sans protocole). Mes constats sont tous mineurs : aucune valeur fausse trouvée. Fragile dans ma lecture : les colonnes de Supp. Table 1 et le choix de la bonne valeur pour 3LCVO-ABR (je ne peux pas trancher entre Table 1 et Supp. Table 1) ; la relecture par les pairs (lue, non citable comme article) montre que l'ajustement XPS porte sur 0LCVO-ABR, 3LCVO-ABR et un troisième échantillon (probablement 3LCVO-SSR), ce qui renforce le doute sur '34.52 %'.
